value.content:
Pip can't stop worrying about tomorrow's big day — what if he forgets his words? #SleepyMeadowStories Oona the owl teaches him a gentle trick: set each worry into a little pouch and tell it, 'you can wait for morning,' so tonight he can finally rest.

This video uses AI narration and AI-generated illustrations.

#BedtimeStory #PipTheBunny #BedtimeWorries #CalmBedtime
